intro: Pilot Stonegear of Kharanos is looking for someone with true dwarven grit to spruce up his beloved siege engine, Trollplow. To test an aspiring adventurer's mettle, he sends them west into the perilous cavern known as the Grizzled Den to hunt savage wendigos for their thick pelts.

clips.title: Quest text
paras: Driving a Siege Engine isn't for everyone. It takes an iron grip and nerves of steel...lucky I have both! How about you? How's your mettle? Want to prove it to me?

Well...I'm looking to make my engine, Trollplow, a little more cozy. How about you get me a heap of Wendigo Manes from the Grizzled Den, west of Kharanos. Those manes would make a great rug for Trollplow's inside deck!

clips.title: Progress
paras: Hey, friend. Been to the Grizzled Den yet? Those Wendigos can be fierce.

clips.title: Completion
paras: Ah yes, these manes will work great! You show a lot of grit, adventurer - I wager we'll see great things from you.
